title: Asana Wooden House Siem Reap: Khmer 19th Hole Bar
description: Sip infused rice spirits and craft cocktails in the last traditional Khmer wooden house in Siem Reap. The ultimate 19th hole unwind after Angkor golf.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Asana Old Wooden House in Siem Reap offers a unique 1.5-hour heritage experience, featuring traditional Khmer wooden architecture and locally infused rice spirits. Guests recline in hammocks or on floor cushions, with tasting flights and cocktails like sour ginger and wild honey available.
> * This experience is best paired with early evening relaxation before exploring Pub Street, and requires advance booking for year-round availability. AGS provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers.
> * The venue focuses on 'Sra Sor', a traditional Cambodian rice wine, infused with local herbs to create a unique cocktail menu. The atmosphere is described as profoundly local, wooden, and relaxed, with a smart casual dress code.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Drink inside the last remaining traditional Khmer wooden house in the center of Siem Reap, suspended in hammocks and sipping locally infused rice spirits.

## The Operator & Origin Story
While the surrounding streets have been paved and modernized, Asana preserved a beautiful, stilted wooden house. They focus heavily on 'Sra Sor', the potent traditional Cambodian rice wine, infusing it heavily with local herbs to create a unique cocktail menu.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Ascend the wooden stairs into the open-air, stilted living space. Avoid standard chairs and recline in the traditional woven hammocks or oversized floor cushions. 

Order a tasting flight of infused rice spirits or a complex cocktail utilizing sour ginger and wild honey. The atmosphere is profoundly local, wooden, and relaxed.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Heritage, Relaxed, Authentic |
| **Duration** | 1.5 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | None |
| **Best Paired With** | Early evening relaxation before exploring Pub Street. |

## Siem Reap’s Most Authentic 19th Hole After Angkor Golf Resort
Tucked down a lantern-lit alley in Siem Reap’s Old Market quarter—preserving the last traditional wooden stilt house in the central entertainment zone—**Asana Old Wooden House** is our favorite 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM "decompression 19th hole" after playing [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/), [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), or [Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club](/courses/cambodia/siem-reap-booyoung/). Located 8 minutes by private SUV from [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), and [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/), Asana lets a fourball kick off their shoes, stretch out on woven floor cushions or porch hammocks, and tally scorecards over small-batch Khmer botanical infusions before dinner.

## Khmer Cocktail Masterclass & Spice-Infused Tasting Flights
* **Indigenous Herb & Rice-Spirit Alchemy:** Asana’s bartenders macerate local glutinous rice spirit (*Sombai*) and premium white rums with wild honey, red Kampot pepper, galangal, kaffir lime leaf, tamarind, and bird’s-eye chili. Groups can opt for a guided 45-minute Khmer cocktail-making session around the timber bar, shaking two bespoke drinks each alongside crispy lotus-root and lemongrass bar snacks.
* **Effortless Pre-Dinner Sequencing:** Because Asana’s breezy upper deck peaks during twilight, your group enjoys the calmest hours of the evening before strolling two minutes to [Miss Wong Cocktail Bar](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-miss-wong-cocktail-bar/) or transferring to [Cuisine Wat Damnak](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-cuisine-wat-damnak/) for dinner.

## Private Veranda Buyouts & Siem Reap Resort Connectivity
For golf groups of 8 to 16 travelers on [The Khmer Temple Trail](/tours/the-khmer-temple-trail/) or [Cambodia Angkor Odyssey](/tours/cambodia-angkor-odyssey/), Asia Golf Specialists can reserve Asana’s entire upper wooden stilt veranda exclusively from 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM after your round at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) or [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/). Your dedicated luxury MPVs depart directly from [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/), or [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/), giving your flight a breezy private clubhouse setting to settle the day’s skins game over Kampot-pepper gin tonics and lemongrass rice-spirit flights before dinner.

faqs.q: What makes Asana Old Wooden House an ideal post-golf 19th hole in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Set inside the last surviving traditional timber stilt house in Siem Reap's Old Market quarter—just 12 minutes from Angkor Golf Resort—Asana offers hammock seating, chilled towels, and Khmer herb-infused cocktails in a relaxed early-evening setting.

faqs.q: Can our golf group book a private Khmer cocktail workshop at Asana?
faqs.a: Yes. Asia Golf Specialists arranges private 60-to-90-minute Khmer mixology sessions on Asana's upper wooden veranda for groups of 4 to 16 players, using fresh lemongrass, Kampot pepper, and tamarind.

faqs.q: What is the dress code at Asana Wooden House in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Clean resort casual or smart golf polo attire is welcome; the open-air wooden deck is informal and relaxed, making it an easy stop before dinner at The Sugar Palm or Cuisine Wat Damnak.
